The more technical term would be **"selongsong"** or **"pengulir"**, but **"gelang tenun"** might be most transparent. Given you want one word, I'd suggest **"pengulir"** or just accept the ambiguity and use **"alat tenun."** Hmm, actually in traditional weaving, the shuttle is often called **"gelang"** in Indonesian. Let me go with **"gelang"** if that's standard, otherwise **"pengulir"** (roller/shuttle).
